description: This file defines classes and functions related to operator support and compatibility checks within the torch.fx framework, including support for node type checking, support combination, and support filtering based on node attributes.

classes.name: OperatorSupportBase
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for checking if a torch.fx.Node is supported by a backend.

classes.name: OperatorSupport
classes.description: Concrete implementation of OperatorSupportBase that uses a support dictionary to determine node support based on target type and input dtypes.

classes.name: OpSupports
classes.description: Utility class providing atomic operator support filters, such as declining support based on input dtype or node name.

methods.name: is_node_supported
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a given torch.fx.Node is supported, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: create_op_support
methods.description: Wraps a custom function into an OperatorSupportBase instance.

methods.name: chain
methods.description: Combines multiple OperatorSupportBase instances into one that supports a node only if all do.

methods.name: any_chain
methods.description: Combines multiple OperatorSupportBase instances into one that supports a node if any do.

methods.name: decline_if_input_dtype
methods.description: Returns an OperatorSupportBase that declines support if any input node has the specified dtype.

methods.name: decline_if_node_in_names
methods.description: Returns an OperatorSupportBase that declines support if the node's name is in the disallow set.
